hero.description: I design and build tools and systems that improve the productivity of engineering teams and end users. For 9+ years, I've been identifying inefficiencies in workflows and turning them into tools, automation, and platforms.

about.title: About
about.description: Rather than a feature developer in a specific domain, I'm an engineer who designs and implements tools and systems that enhance productivity for development teams and end users. From DRC systems in the EDA/PCB domain to CI/CD pipelines, AI code review PoCs, and onboarding automation — I design tools that fit real usage flows and complete them at production-ready quality.
